description: the creator of worlds, a slim woman with fair light skin, long wavy dark brown hair hanging straight down her back at rest, not flying, eyes glowing white, a small tiara of white crystal shining with light, a long gown of deep cosmic black and dark blue full of tiny stars with golden trim and golden nebula patterns, wide sleeves, the gown down to the ankles, soft dark slippers, a bright beautiful young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, no staff, no orbiting worlds, no ring of runes and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: face, hair, crystal tiara, starry gown, colours and drawing style; not the sitting pose and not the hands on the reins: she stands and walks
the character's look in detail: face, hair, crystal tiara, starry gown and colours; the hands empty, without the staff, the orbiting worlds and the ring of runes
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
